description: Demo step 4 (stale factor). A demo copy of the electricity-water-intensity factor as it stood with Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory's 2016 figure, and the newer LBNL 2024 figure that Tavily finds. Both quotes are verbatim from the real reports. The signed registry is never touched by the demo.

entry.label: Water consumed per kWh of electricity generated (EWIF)
entry.source_title: United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, 2016)
entry.evidence: A national average of 7.6 liters (2.0 gallons) of water are consumed for each kWh when weighting the water losses at both thermoelectric and hydroelectric plants in the U.S.

newer.source_title: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory)
newer.evidence: In 2023, energy consumption by a data center translates to national average of 4.52 L/kWh of indirect water consumption, along with 0.34 kg/ kWh emissions.
